summary.short: Shenzhen municipal measures issued 18 Dec 2024 (valid 2 years) to support AI development: vouchers and grants for compute, models, corpora and applications, plus R&D, incubation and talent support for AI firms and research bodies.
summary.long: Issued by the Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology (深工信规〔2024〕13号) after municipal government approval, effective 18 December 2024 for two years. The measures set out funding and in-kind support for AI in Shenzhen in five parts. Part one provides compute-service discounts and 'training vouchers' (up to 500 million yuan a year) covering up to 50% of contract value for model training, plus 'corpus vouchers' funding purchases of non-affiliated corpora. Part two offers 'model vouchers' (up to 100 million yuan a year) for use of filed generative AI models, grants for industry application demonstrations, opening of government application scenarios, and subsidies for AI hardware and software. Part three funds basic research and technology projects, open-source and ecosystem centres, public technology platforms and key laboratories. Part four provides rent-free incubator space, park awards, talent start-up grants, financing subsidies and industry events. Part five bars double-claiming against other municipal incentives, caps funding by annual totals, limits cumulative project funding to audited investment where national or provincial support exists, and allows adjustment to implementing rules. Responsibilities are assigned to named municipal bureaus.

notes: Departmental issuance (深工信规〔2024〕13号) by the Shenzhen municipal industry and IT bureau, stated as approved by the municipal government (已经市政府同意). It sets funding and support measures (vouchers, grants, rewards, rent and financing support) and cites no enabling act. Most amounts are maxima ('最高'). Annual totals cap several measures, and the 附则 says the measures may not be combined with other same-type municipal incentives. Duration: 'in force from 2024-12-18, valid 2 years'. The text contains no internal inconsistency that I found. Responsible units are given per measure; they are coded as designated entities. The provincial instrument is cited only as a spirit to implement, and the national CAC filing regime is referenced without being named. target_instrument_id is empty where the target is outside the registry. Only relations and entities were requested; section_status is filled only because the schema requires it.

definitions.note: The text defines no terms. 人工智能, 初创企业, 中小微企业, 非关联方, 训力券 and 语料券 are used without definition.

enforcement.note: The text is a set of subsidy and incentive measures (训力券, 语料券, 模型券, grants, rewards, rent-free periods). It contains no fines, criminal penalties, licence revocation, suspension, blocking or injunctions. Its only restrictive language is in 五、附则: subsidies are not to be stacked with other city measures, annual totals are capped, cumulative funding for a project may not exceed its audited investment, and implementing rules are to be issued. None of these is a sanction. No clawback or repayment provision was found, so no enforcement row is coded.
